answer: Documented unmet needs for palbociclib-based therapy include: (1) Efficacy—PALOMA-2 final OS analysis showed no statistically significant survival benefit (53.9 vs 51.2 months, HR=0.956), and real-world data show markedly lower PFS in later-line use (7.8 months) versus first-line (22.8 months). (2) Safety/tolerability—risk of severe ILD/pneumonitis requiring permanent discontinuation, plus cytopenia monitoring needs; pooled data show 38.4% require dose modification and 5.2% permanently discontinue due to adverse reactions. (3) Access/adherence—overall survival and payer value data remain immature for newer maintenance indications, and added burdens like contraception/fertility counseling may affect adherence in underserved populations.
